title: Medical & dental practices
summary: Hygiene-focused cleaning of practices and clinics, following documented protocols.

meta.title: Cleaning for medical and dental practices in Luxembourg
meta.description: Hygiene-focused cleaning of medical, dental and paramedical practices in Luxembourg, following documented protocols and colour-coded methods.

hero.intro: Patients judge a practice by its cleanliness. We follow documented hygiene protocols, colour-coded equipment and the instructions of your practice, every visit.

image.alt: A spotless dental treatment room with clean, clear surfaces

included.intro: Our scope covers environmental cleaning. Sterilisation of instruments and medical devices remains the responsibility of your clinical staff.

groups.title: Patient areas
items: Waiting rooms, reception desks and seating
Door handles, switches, card terminals and other contact points disinfected
Floors cleaned with methods suited to clinical areas

groups.title: Treatment rooms
items: Surfaces, sinks and fittings cleaned and disinfected, as instructed by the practice
Colour-coded cloths and mops to prevent cross-contamination
Non-clinical waste removed; clinical waste left for your licensed collector

groups.title: Documentation
items: Written cleaning protocol agreed with the practice
Cleaning logs kept for each visit
Safety data sheets for every product used

options.title: Several times a week

options.title: Periodic deep clean

audience.title: Dental practices

audience.title: Paramedical practices

faq.question: Are your staff trained for medical environments?
faq.answer: Staff assigned to practices are trained in hygiene protocols, colour coding and the safe handling of products, and follow your specific instructions.

faq.question: Do you handle clinical waste?
faq.answer: No. Clinical and infectious waste must go through a licensed collector. We remove ordinary waste and leave clinical waste containers untouched.

faq.question: Which products do you use?
faq.answer: Professional detergents and disinfectants suited to medical environments. We provide safety data sheets and can use the products your practice specifies.
